# FM Bomboniere di Francesca Moliterni

> Showcase website of a bomboniere (wedding and celebration favours) and gift shop in Scalea (CS), Calabria, Italy. Single-page site in Italian and English with a gallery of recent work. No e-commerce, no prices.

## Business

- Name: FM Bomboniere di Francesca Moliterni, "Bomboniere e Articoli da Regalo"
- Occasions: matrimonio (wedding), battesimo (baptism), comunione, cresima, nascita (birth), laurea (graduation), gift items
- Address: Via Tommaso Campanella 33, 87029 Scalea (CS), Italia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +39 377 380 2773
- Email: moliternifrancesca91@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fmbombonierescalea/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61556412425114

## Site

- [Home](./): sections #chi-siamo (about), #collezioni (collections), #galleria (gallery), #contatti (contact)

## Design system

- [DESIGN.md](design/DESIGN.md): design contract (color roles with WCAG ratios, typography, layout, components, motion, reduced motion, prohibited patterns)
- [fm.tokens.json](design/fm.tokens.json): design tokens in W3C DTCG format
- [components.json](design/components.json): component contracts (props, behaviour, accessibility)
